citation.title: Simultaneous feedback control of plasma rotation and stored energy on NSTX-U using Neoclassical Toroidal Viscosity and Neutral Beam Injection
citation.authors: I. R. Goumiri, C. W. Rowley, S. A. Sabbagh, D. A. Gates, M. D. Boyer, S. P. Gerhardt, E. Kolemen, J. E. Menard
citation.year: unknown (the extracted text shows no publication year)
citation.venue: unknown (the extracted manuscript text shows no venue)

topic: Model-based LQG/integral feedback control of toroidal rotation profile and stored energy on NSTX-U. Actuators are NBI and NTV. Tests are closed-loop simulations with predictive TRANSP.
own_question: Can a reduced momentum and energy model support simultaneous tracking of rotation and beta_N/stored energy under actuator constraints?
actual_method_and_evidence: The authors build a Bessel-projected 1D momentum diffusion model and a first-order stored-energy ODE. Parameters come from an extrapolated TRANSP scenario, 142301X, which is not real NSTX-U data. They add a Kalman observer using five sensor channels, a robustness analysis with perturbed chi_phi and tau_E, and PWM beam constraints. The controller is tested only in simulation, with no experimental validation. No CES, BES or ECEI nowcasting is involved.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Rotation-profile control work has used observers that reconstruct the state from a few rotation measurement channels in simulation.
claim_checks.qualification: The observer is used for control. It is not a measurement nowcast. Sensors are simulated TRANSP outputs, and the diagnostic type is not specified as CES.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The controller is discrete with a 6 ms duty cycle, used to accommodate beam switching constraints. This is not a diagnostic report latency.
validation_if_relevant: Validation consists of model-to-TRANSP comparisons with roughly 25% relative error and perturbed-plant robustness checks. There is no held-out experimental data.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper as CES temperature nowcasting or as evidence on CES latency.
Do not claim the controller was validated experimentally on NSTX-U.
Do not transfer its 6 ms duty cycle to our 10 ms computation budget.
Do not use it to characterize all prior rotation control as observer-based.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, it could appear in one optional sentence on downstream applications in rotation and profile control. It does not address our estimation target, our diagnostics or our validation question.
